about: Vallarith's Post-Reform arcs for the director (dungeon/director.py), from worlds/vallarith/beats.json and hidden-truths.json. Each stage has its tier, what the world knows of it (truth), a seed the narrator may plant, and how it reaches a character who is not there (word). Drafts for Vanta to keep, change or cut.

arcs.name: The Eight Pieces
arcs.seen: Something about the Heartwood contract is wrong, and the Cyrel buyer wants the grove down too badly.

antagonist.name: Gannet & Pryce's agent
antagonist.agenda: to see the Heartwood felled before the wardens or the shrine can stop it, and to buy whoever stands in the way

stages.truth: Under the Heartwood an arm of Asmodeus lies held by the roots, and Gannet & Pryce, who are paying for the felling, are a Mammon cult front.
stages.seed: A root cut at the edge of the grove bleeds dark sap that smells of hot iron.
stages.word: Felling crews say the Heartwood's roots bleed when cut.

stages.truth: Gannet & Pryce send a second buyer to Kingswood with gold for the reeve, and a contract signed in old infernal ink.
stages.seed: A Gannet & Pryce contract on a table: the ink is brown and the signatures do not dry.
stages.word: A clerk from Cyrel is buying drinks for the reeve's men, and paying in new gold.

stages.truth: A Hellfire cult preaches openly in an engineered city when its wards fail, and its preachers speak of the arm under the Heartwood.
stages.seed: A travelling preacher draws a closed hand in the dust and asks who has seen the old trees bleed.
stages.word: Word from the south: a Hellfire cult preaches in the open where the wards failed.

stages.truth: Another piece surfaces: an arm, in a Ley mine, and Naamah's eyes and Mephistopheles's cult race each other for it.
stages.seed: A miner's token from a Ley mine, warm, with a fingermark burned into it.
stages.word: A Ley mine has been closed and its miners paid to forget something.

stages.truth: A New God takes notice of who has been digging up the pieces of Asmodeus.
stages.seed: Every shrine candle in town gutters at once, and leans toward the character.
stages.word: The priests say a god is watching the roads, and none of them will say which.

arcs.name: The Long Border
arcs.seen: The Badlands are too quiet, and Bastion's soldiers are running.

antagonist.name: Mister Ambry
antagonist.agenda: a devil in clean robes, courting Murga Hollowtooth to open the passes in exchange for power, and anyone else who will sign

stages.truth: The Unguruk have stopped raiding and started building siege works at Adlmyr.
stages.seed: A deserter's boots, cut from Cyrel leather, left by a cold fire: someone ran from Bastion in a hurry.
stages.word: Carters from the Badlands road say the Unguruk are digging, not raiding.

stages.truth: Bastion's deserters flood Kingswood and Convila, and the levy officers hang the ones they catch.
stages.seed: A boy with a soldier's haircut and no soldier's coat flinches at the sound of a horn.
stages.word: Bastion's men are deserting by the dozen, and the levy officers are hanging them.

stages.truth: A polite stranger in clean robes visits the Bastion commander too, with the same offer he made Murga Hollowtooth.
stages.seed: A pleasant man in robes too clean for the road asks the way to Bastion, and thanks the character by name.
stages.word: A stranger in clean robes has been seen at Bastion, and again at Adlmyr.

stages.truth: Unguruk opens the passes, or does not; whichever Murga chose, the border will not be the same.
stages.seed: Smoke on the Badlands horizon, in a line, like a road being lit.
stages.word: The passes are open, or about to be: nobody agrees which, and everyone is packing.

arcs.name: The Failing Wards
arcs.seen: The old ward-stones at the Abandoned Keep are failing, and something on the other side knows it.

antagonist.name: Haggoth's gnoll-priests
antagonist.agenda: to leave offerings at the portal scar until the last ward-stone cracks and the door opens again

stages.truth: Gnolls have begun leaving offerings at the portal scar under the Abandoned Keep.
stages.seed: Bones tied with red cord, hung from a thorn on the keep road, all pointing the same way.
stages.word: Shepherds near the keep say someone is leaving bones on the thorns.

stages.truth: A Kingswood elder pays in secret to have the ward-stones renewed, knowing the keep was built over the door Himo Xiloscient let open.
stages.seed: An old Kingswood charter with a page cut out, and the name Xiloscient scratched from the stone beside the green.
stages.word: Someone in Kingswood is paying stonecutters to go out to the keep, and paying them to keep quiet.

stages.truth: Brynwyr wardens arrive at the keep and will not say why.
stages.seed: Grey-fletched arrows in the keep's old gate, pointing outward.
stages.word: Elves have been seen at the Abandoned Keep, standing guard.

stages.truth: The portal scar is warm in summer now, and the ground around the keep hums at night.
stages.seed: The stones of the keep road are warm at midnight, and the frost will not settle on them.
stages.word: The ground at the keep is warm, and nothing grows on it.

stages.seed: Every dog in Kingswood howls toward the west at the same moment, and then stops.
stages.word: Something has come through at the keep. The shepherds have left the hills.
